name: Paprika Pork Chops with Sautéed Bell Pepper, Mango & Red Onion

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the bell peppers lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Slice the quarters crosswise into small strips and transfer to a large bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onions and remove the outer layer; cut lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with paprika, salt, and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, bone-in
3 tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate.
While the pork chops cook, peel the mangoes, then slice off the flesh from the pit, starting with the flatter sides; discard the pit and large dice the flesh (cut into 2-cm cubes).
Once the pork chops have been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet.
Add the bell peppers and onion to the skillet; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are just tender, 2 to 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the mangoes to the skillet; stir to combine and continue cooking for an additional 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from the heat.
To serve, divide the pork chops and sauté between plates. Enjoy!
